description: Primary index: predicted probability that the entrance is accessible under the rule label after the human review of gates and ramps (accessible_rule), from the final logistic model.
5th percentile of p_accessible over bootstrap refits (parameter uncertainty only).
95th percentile of p_accessible over bootstrap refits.
Out-of-fold probability from 5-fold CV (only for buildings with a training label). Use this, not p_accessible, to compare with labels.
Alternative index: same model specification trained on the AI-only label (accessible_rule_ai).
5th percentile of p_accessible_ai_only over bootstrap refits.
95th percentile of p_accessible_ai_only over bootstrap refits.
Out-of-fold probability of the AI-only index (only for buildings with an AI-only training label).
Building lies in one of the seven labelled neighbourhoods.
Land use and building class each occur >= 5 times among training labels.
All observed numeric predictors within the 1st-99th percentile of the training sample.
Version tag of the model specification.
